programme.title: Barah Aana
programme.desc: Three men accidentally stumble into the world of crime when they start kidnapping for small ransoms in order to improve their lifestyles. However, they soon realise that it is not a bad business.

programme.title: Blood Relation
programme.desc: Full of action and drama.

programme.title: 16 December
programme.desc: Four Indian Revenue Service officers are assigned to intercept and arrest a group of Pakistani terrorists. The terrorists plot to detonate a nuclear bomb in New Delhi and the IRS must stop them.

programme.title: China Gate
programme.desc: Colonel Puri requests his former fellow army officers court-martialed in disgrace to redeem themselves by rescuing a village from Jageera, an evil bandit.

programme.title: Ghatak
programme.desc: When Kashi visits a community with his father, he is shocked to see the torturous regime of Katya. He tries to oppose Katya, but ends up compromising the safety of his family and relatives.

programme.title: Lashkar
programme.desc: Anand, a professor, meddles with Sangram Singh, a gangster, but he gets acquitted in court. When Sangram seeks revenge, Anand joins hands with a policeman to defeat the crook.

programme.title: Katilon Ke Kaatil
programme.desc: A wealthy widow meets Munna and Ajit and assumes them to be her estranged sons. She takes them into her house, unaware that their intentions are to loot her entire wealth.

programme.title: Satya
programme.desc: Durga's brother is killed in a gang war, turning him into a revenge-seeking man with a mission. Now, his ex-girlfriends cop husband is out to get him. Finally, the two team up to nab the real culprit.

programme.title: Pyaar Ka Safar
programme.desc: Bharath has lost everything since his childhood including his love. He is supported by his childhood friend Bhargava. Does Bhargava help him or will he end up destroying him completely.

programme.title: Dharmyudh
programme.desc: A successful man tries to reconnect with his old teacher only to find out that she is in deep trouble. Upon learning this, he decides to do everything he can to save her.

programme.title: Nazar Ke Samne
programme.desc: Jai, an unemployed drunk, gives false testimony that puts an innocent man in jail for murder. However, he later relents and tries to exonerate him by searching for the real killer.

programme.title: Sikandar Sadak Ka
programme.desc: Sikander, an honest union worker, is harassed and sent to jail when he tries to stop the unscrupulous activities of his evil employer. After he gets released, he sets out to destroy him.

programme.title: Mr. Natwarlal
programme.desc: When Natwar's elder brother is framed for bribery, he decides to avenge his brother's humiliation and thus poses as a crime lord.

programme.title: Jaan Se Pyaara
programme.desc: Inspector Jai arrests Guman only to release him after he threatens to destroy the city. Later, Jai's brother, who has a cognitive disability, gets abducted in return for a mysterious bag.

programme.title: Mera Faisla
programme.desc: Raj wishes to marry Rati but faces humiliation from her father due to the stigma associated with his lineage. Soon, he decides to join the police force to restore his family's honour.

programme.title: Azad Desh Ka Andha Kanoon
programme.desc: A brash and honest policeman is torn apart between his duties and saving his family when his own brother is caught in a blue-film scam. He also must protect a sole witness whose life is in danger.

programme.title: Farz
programme.desc: Gopal, a secret agent, investigates the death of his colleague who possessed evidence against a known terrorist. Gopal and Kamla embark on a journey to find the traitor.

programme.title: Kehte Hain Muzko Raaja
programme.desc: Action Movie.

programme.title: Krishna Arjun
programme.desc: Sharda Yadav, a widow, lives with her two sons, Krishna and Arjun. Arjun is studying in Mumbai when he hears that his mother has passed away and Krishna has been arrested for raping a widow.

programme.title: Pyar Ke Kabil
programme.desc: Kiran and Jyoti are twins who were separated after their parents uncoupled. Years later, they meet accidentally at a picnic and decide to exchange places in an effort to reunite their parents.

programme.title: Josh
programme.desc: Max, who lives with his twin sister Shirley in Goa, is enraged when he finds out that she has fallen in love with Rahul, his bitter rival Prakash's younger brother.

programme.title: Hiraasat
programme.desc: ACP Ashok Saxena is an honest middle-class police officer who lives with his wife, Shobha, and college-going brother, Rajesh. However, he is framed in a case of drug-trafficking and gets arrested.

programme.title: Rustum
programme.desc: ACP Abhishek Bhargav is determined to find the culprits behind the death of his friend, DCP Bharath. His investigation takes him to Bangalore, where he uncovers revelations of an organ trade mafia.

programme.title: Nakshatra
programme.desc: Ajay works on a new script, which is based on a robbery of an expensive necklace, for some producers. However, things take a turn when the scene is enacted in real-life and the blame falls on Ajay.

programme.title: Papi Gudia
programme.desc: A criminal uses a possessed doll to lure children and kill them. His latest target is Raju, the young brother of a dancer, who soon becomes the main suspect in a series of murders.

programme.title: Buniyad
programme.desc: he storyline involves a vengeful ex-convict who attempts to start a new life and deals with a "wicked woman" who tries to destroy the lives of those around him.

programme.title: Ek Se Bure Do
programme.desc: Jagat, a gangster, hires Toti and Tony to steal a treasure map. But they provide him with a fake copy of the map and reserve the original. When Jagat learns about it, he plans to teach them a lesson.

programme.title: Alice in Wonderland
programme.desc: A girl meets a mysterious talking rabbit and follows the creature down a hole in the ground. She finds herself in a magical world inhabited by all manner of bizarre creatures and dominated by a short-tempered queen fond of beheading those who displease her. Disney animated fantasy based on Lewis Carroll's novel, with the voices of Kathryn Beaumont and Ed Wynn.

programme.title: Up
programme.desc: An old man attaches thousands of balloons to his house so he can fly it to South America, and fulfil his late wife's dream of exploring the jungle. However, once airborne, he finds he has an unwanted stowaway in the shape of an excitable boy scout. Pixar animated adventure, with the voices of Ed Asner, Jordan Nagai and Christopher Plummer.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
programme.desc: Four children are evacuated from London during the Second World War and sent to a rural manor house where they discover a secret entrance to the mystical world of Narnia. There they help vanquish the wicked White Witch, whose curse has gripped the land in perpetual winter. Fantasy adventure based on the book by CS Lewis, with Tilda Swinton, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell, William Moseley, James McAvoy and Jim Broadbent, and featuring the voice of Liam Neeson.

programme.title: The Good Dinosaur
programme.desc: In a world where the asteroid impact that wiped out the dinosaurs never happened, humans have evolved as a primitive species while the giant lizards remain the dominant life form on Earth. A young apatosaurus becomes separated from his family, but finds a friend in a feral human boy as he makes the dangerous journey home. Pixar animated adventure, with the voices of Raymond Ochoa and Jack Bright.

programme.title: Finding Nemo
programme.desc: Clownfish Nemo becomes separated from his friends on the Great Barrier Reef - but the thrill of being able to swim freely and away from his overprotective father turns to horror when he is netted by a diver. His distraught dad sets out on a mission to find him, while the youngster finds himself in a dentist's tropical tank. Animated adventure, with the voices of Albert Brooks, Ellen DeGeneres, Alexander Gould, Willem Dafoe, Barry Humphries and Geoffrey Rush.

programme.title: Percy Jackson: Sea of Monsters
programme.desc: The modern-day teenage son of the Greek god Poseidon must lead his friends on a perilous journey into the Bermuda triangle. They need to recover the legendary Golden Fleece to save the world, but getting to it means braving all manner of terrifying monsters. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Logan Lerman and Alexandra Daddario.

programme.title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
programme.desc: An old man tells a journalist the story of his youth as a lobby boy at a hotel in Eastern Europe in the 1930s. He was taken under the wing of the establishment's dashing concierge, and is drawn into his misadventures as he becomes involved in a conflict over a valuable painting. Wes Anderson's comedy drama, starring Ralph Fiennes, Tony Revolori, F Murray Abraham and Jude Law.

programme.title: Black Swan
programme.desc: A repressed ballet dancer leads a sheltered life, devoted entirely to her art. She pursues the lead role in a production of Swan Lake, but the director convinces her she will only be capable of dancing the part if she embraces her darker impulses. This leads her into a destructive relationship with a rival that threatens her sanity. Drama, starring an Oscar-winning Natalie Portman. With Mila Kunis, Vincent Cassel and Winona Ryder.

programme.title: Iron Man
programme.desc: Arms manufacturer Tony Stark is taken hostage by a terrorist group and realises the weapons his company build have been falling into the wrong hands. Using his engineering skills to construct a hi-tech armoured suit, he manages to escape and then puts the technology to good use in the fight against evil around the world. Superhero adventure, starring Robert Downey Jr, Jeff Bridges, Gwyneth Paltrow and Terrence Howard.

programme.title: A Real Pain
programme.desc: Mismatched cousins David and Benji reunite for a tour through Poland to honour their beloved grandmother. Comedy drama, starring an Oscar and Bafta-winning Kieran Culkin, and Jesse Eisenberg, who also directed and won a Bafta for Best Original Screenplay.

programme.title: Percy Jackson: Sea of Monsters
programme.desc: The modern-day teenage son of the Greek god Poseidon must lead his friends on a perilous journey into the Bermuda triangle. They need to recover the legendary Golden Fleece to save the world, but getting to it means braving all manner of terrifying monsters. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Logan Lerman and Alexandra Daddario.

programme.title: The Tigger Movie
programme.desc: Tigger realises being the only one of his kind makes for a lonely life, so he sets off on a bold quest to find more creatures just like him, with the help of his woodland friends. Animated adventure, with the voices of Jim Cummings, Nikita Hopkins, Ken Sansom, John Fiedler, Tom Attenborough and Peter Cullen.

programme.title: Ratatouille
programme.desc: A rat finds his love of fine food has made him an outcast to his less discerning family. Separated from his fellow rodents by a storm, he winds up in a famous French restaurant, where he helps an incompetent kitchen assistant become the greatest chef in Paris. Animated comedy from the director of The Incredibles, with the voices of Patton Oswalt, Ian Holm, Lou Romano and Peter O'Toole.

programme.title: Alice in Wonderland
programme.desc: A girl meets a mysterious talking rabbit and follows the creature down a hole in the ground. She finds herself in a magical world inhabited by all manner of bizarre creatures and dominated by a short-tempered queen fond of beheading those who displease her. Disney animated fantasy based on Lewis Carroll's novel, with the voices of Kathryn Beaumont and Ed Wynn.

programme.title: Hannah Montana: The Movie
programme.desc: As her pop starlet alter-ego Hannah Montana's fame begins to grow, teenager Miley Stewart gets carried away with the success and is sent to work on the family farm in Tennessee. With help from her faithful friends, she begins to discover who she really is and what is important in life. Family comedy, starring real-life father and daughter Miley and Billy Ray Cyrus, alongside Emily Osment, Jason Earles and Mitchel Musso.

programme.title: A Goofy Movie
programme.desc: The Disney cartoon dog takes his son on an old-fashioned fishing trip in an attempt to bond with the lad. However, young Max has boasted to his pals that he is going to a pop concert in Los Angeles, and has a few ideas on how to trick his dopey dad. Animated comedy, featuring the voices of Bill Farmer, Jason Marsden and Wallace Shawn.

programme.title: The Wild
programme.desc: The son of a lion kept in a zoo in Central Park is crated up and shipped to Africa. His worried father musters a band of fellow creatures and escapes from captivity in a quest to rescue the youngster. Animated comedy, featuring the voices of Kiefer Sutherland, James Belushi, Eddie Izzard, Janeane Garofalo and William Shatner.

programme.title: Finding Nemo
programme.desc: Clownfish Nemo becomes separated from his friends on the Great Barrier Reef - but the thrill of being able to swim freely and away from his overprotective father turns to horror when he is netted by a diver. Animated adventure, with the voices of Albert Brooks, Ellen DeGeneres, Alexander Gould, Willem Dafoe, Barry Humphries and Geoffrey Rush.

programme.title: The Jungle Book
programme.desc: A boy is raised by animals in the jungles of India, but his carefree life is threatened by the return of a fierce tiger with a grudge against humans. The youngster faces a difficult choice between remaining with his friends or returning to his own people. Live action remake of Disney's animated adventure based on Rudyard Kipling's stories, starring Neel Sethi, with the voices of Bill Murray, Ben Kingsley and Idris Elba.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe

programme.title: Conan the Barbarian
programme.desc: A child who grows up in slavery becomes a formidable warrior and a cunning thief. Taken prisoner by a victorious king, he is sent out to destroy the leader of the barbaric cult that destroyed his village and slaughtered his family. Fantasy adventure, based on the stories by author Robert E Howard, starring Arnold Schwarzenegger, Max von Sydow, James Earl Jones and Sandahl Bergman.

programme.title: Hitchcock

After being refused backing by the studio Hitchcock decides to pay for it himself in exchange for a percentage of the profits. Even with His wifes support, Alma Reville, the production strains the couples marriage. Fact-based drama, starring Anthony Hopkins, Helen Mirren and Scarlett Johansson.

programme.title: Flightplan
programme.desc: A widow boards a plane with her daughter and promptly falls asleep. When she wakes up, the girl has disappeared - and the mother's fear turns to outright panic when the aircraft crew insists she boarded the flight alone, suggesting the child is merely a figment of her distressed imagination. Thriller, starring Jodie Foster, Peter Sarsgaard, Sean Bean and Greta Scacchi.

programme.title: National Treasure

He has to contend with determined rivals in the shape of a treacherous associate and the FBI. Action adventure, starring Nicolas Cage, Diane Kruger, Sean Bean and Justin Bartha.

programme.title: Inspector Gadget

Comedy adventure based on the 1980s cartoon series, starring Matthew Broderick, Rupert Everett and Joely Fisher.

programme.title: Ratatouille

Animated comedy from the director of The Incredibles, with the voices of Patton Oswalt, Ian Holm, Lou Romano and Peter O'Toole.

Pixar animated adventure sequel, with the voices of Owen Wilson and Michael Caine.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe

There they help vanquish the wicked White Witch, whose curse has gripped the land in perpetual winter. Fantasy adventure based on the book by CS Lewis, with Tilda Swinton, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell, William Moseley, James McAvoy and Jim Broadbent, and featuring the voice of Liam Neeson.

Disney animated fantasy adventure, with the voices of Kristen Bell and Idina Menzel.

programme.title: Maleficent

She swears to get revenge on him by placing a curse on his daughter, only to find herself developing a maternal bond with the girl. Fantasy adventure based on the story of Sleeping Beauty, starring Angelina Jolie, Elle Fanning, Sharlto Copley and Imelda Staunton.

Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Logan Lerman and Alexandra Daddario.

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress: Atlanta

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress: Atlanta
programme.desc: S6 E7 — Pastor PrincessShaundalyn wants to look sexy on her big day despite her conservative friend's approval. Ashley is looking for a glam dress, but her sassy grandma has other ideas.

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress
programme.desc: S16 E5 — Coco Is Not ImpressedDoga instructor Mariah seeks a princess dress and wants her pup Coco to match! Jami is eloping to Paris, and she needs a dress as magical as her destination.

programme.title: Judge Rinder's Crime Stories

In the case of Amanda Playle, who was stalked by a man she believed was her ex-boyfriend, Sussex Police reveal how their investigations uncovered the identity of her stalker.

programme.title: The Big Swindle

programme.title: American Monster

programme.title: American Monster

programme.title: Evil Lives Here: Shadows of Death

programme.title: Murder on CCTV

programme.title: When Fred Met Rose
programme.desc: Documentary series examining what led Fred and Rose West to become serial killers.

programme.title: Fred and Rose: The West Murders
programme.desc: Focuses on the notorious house which the couple shared in Gloucester. Fred and Rose murdered their first three victims - Anna McFall, Charmaine West and then Rena Costello - because they `got in the way'. But when they moved into 25 Cromwell Street, the couple began to kill for sexual thrills.

programme.title: Fred and Rose: The West Murders
programme.desc: Looks at how a dogged police officer, Hazel Savage, fought to have the Wests' patio excavated when she became suspicious about the whereabouts of their daughter. The film also includes insights from both Fred and Rose West's former solicitors.

programme.title: Britain's Forgotten Serial Killer
programme.desc: This is the chilling but little-known story of Trevor Hardy, the serial killer known as the `Beast of Manchester' who murdered three teenage girls between December 1974 and March 1976.

programme.title: Murderous Minds: Dennis Nilsen
programme.desc: Dennis Andrew Nilsen was a Scottish serial killer and necrophiliac who murdered at least 12 young men and boys in London between 1978 and 1983.

programme.title: Jack the Ripper: London's Most Notorious Killer
programme.desc: Unmasking Jack the Ripper and his evil deeds with a presentation of both factual evidence and conspiracy theories.

programme.title: Heartland Homicide
programme.desc: The small town of Enderby, British Columbia, is shattered after well-loved residents Derk Roelfsema and Audrey Foster-Roelfsema are found murdered in their own home. As rumours fly about the violent crime, authorities struggle to solve the case.

programme.title: Heartland Homicide
programme.desc: Eighteen-year-old Taylor Van Diest is on her way to meet friends when she is assaulted and left for dead. She is discovered by her mother and friends, and succumbs to her injuries the following day.

programme.title: Heartland Homicide
programme.desc: When hardware store clerk Sydney Loofe vanishes after an online date, investigators race against the clock to find her. But as the days wear on, a horrible truth emerges from the darkness.

programme.title: Heartland Homicide

Biologist Patrick Aryee explores how cats have evolved throughout the millennia, learning to thrive in inhospitable environments, as well as becoming the world's most popular pet. In the first edition there is spectacular footage of caracals jumping three metres to catch flying birds, and a rare Bornean bay cat, which was thought to have been extinct. Patrick finds out how tigers made the transition from South-east Asia's steamy jungles to the -40C temperatures of Siberia, and meets 'lion whisperer' Kevin Richardson
